## Discoveries
The previous memory mislabeled #501 as reading-only: its [actual study](../docs/research/0099-writing-version-effort.md) already covers writing, while only the inherited numeric estimates exclude it; the duplicate-research draft was replaced.

## What next
Read the review's report/artifact: correct only evidenced findings after NOT-CLEAR, or close the bounded scope after CLEAR without inventing a full-goal ratio.
If unfinished, resume the preserved task branch/tag; do not repeat completed WM1, POC, F1 or integrity work.
Process any human return by checking the unchanged initial ledger, identities and exposure before targeted disagreement resolution; pending requests do not block ready work.
